summary: A heavy, broad sell-off took Nifty to a fresh 2026 intraday low, with volatility jumping and only IT holding up as oil, rates and foreign selling weighed together.

detail.leaders: Nifty IT (top sector), TCS ahead of results
detail.laggards: Metals (worst sector), Adani Enterprises, JSW Steel, Max Healthcare
detail.tone: The official close was slightly off the auction low: Nifty 22,231.80 (-371.25, -1.64%) and Sensex 71,593.24 (-1,045.46, -1.44%), after a 2026 intraday low of 22,179.90; India VIX rose about 10%.
